"We had a strong start to the year with a record Q1 and delivered one of our highest NGS ARR beats ever as our customers turn to us to protect them against an unprecedented threat environment," said Nikesh Arora, chairman and chief executive officer of Palo Alto Networks. To that end, we are pleased to announce our intent to acquire Applied Compute, which will allow us to deliver secure open weight models to our customers and accelerate the adoption of enterprise AI."
